_note: Kokoro (misaki) phoneme overrides, applied at synthesis only; the word check still uses the plain script. British phoneme set: Q = əʊ, A = eɪ, I = aɪ. Secondary stress on 'tane' keeps isobutane from drifting toward 'isobutene'. Békésy: Hungarian BAY-kay-shee (é = eɪ, s = ʃ). prestin: PRES-tin; the light second stress keeps it from collapsing to 'Preston'.
